Keep anatomical right hand holding full length gold staff, left forearm green gold round shield. Correct shoulder/elbow swings opposite respective leg; equipment follows hands rigidly. Full near-body-height staff, solid golden head backplate with curled relief, and small hanging jade ring with transparent hole. Brown short ponytail, green ribbons, wood bead necklace, gold jade robes armor, ivory pants brown gold boots unchanged. Clear two knees, ankles and toes; preserve far-near occlusion. Body bob and fore-aft limb motion are real redraw, no mirror, no copied pose, no warp. Fixed root x512 y928 on1024 virtual canvas; no individual bbox fit or lowest-foot snap. All head boots props tassels inside canvas. Transparent empty backdrop no shadow text effects. NEW FRAME 5/16: Right toe push-off and left knee forward drive.
